items.name: CVESwooshDirection
items.role: Element in Remastered's SIDE==2 orientation swoosh chain; the port replaces the authored PROT with a camera-and-trail rotation.

items.name: MPT_CVEConvertToXLeftYUpZForward
items.role: Port-only basis change for directions and positions, (x,y,z) to (-x,z,y), self-inverse; the name is the port's.

items.name: MPT_CVEConvertScaleToXLeftYUpZForward
items.role: Port-only basis change for scales, (x,y,z) to (x,z,y), self-inverse; the name is the port's.

items.name: CCoordsExt::UpdateInverseScale
items.role: One component of the inverse-scale calc: FRECPE then two FRECPS refinements. Alias UpdateInverseScale (tests/port_particle_math.cpp:174) merged here.

items.name: CSectionedElementData::Init
items.role: Builds the index shuffler for a constant nonzero count (CRCV); alias Init 0x2a68dc (port_remastered_effect_convert.cpp:1478) merged here.

items.name: Init
items.role: Bare name, class not stated. Runs at a generator's _END before Compile2d 0x2a6b90 (port_remastered_effect_convert.cpp:1329).

items.name: CSectionedElementData::Compile1d
items.role: Constant-0 count takes the owning generator's MAXP and the flag sets a shuffler. Alias Compile2d at 0x2a6ae4 (PortParticleMath.hpp:296) merged; that comment pairs 0x2a6ae4 with Compile1d and 0x2a6b90 with Compile2d.

items.name: CSectionedElementData::Compile2d
items.role: Shuffler and grid for PLNV after Init 0x2a69b8. Alias Compile2d 0x2a6b90 (port_remastered_effect_convert.cpp:1329) merged here.

items.name: CVectorField
items.role: Periodic vector grid loaded from the port's VECF asset; laid out y * (X * Z) + z * X + x.

items.name: ComputeFieldVector
items.role: Field-vector lookup in the same grid as CVectorField (shares its comment).

items.name: CGenDescription::Compile
items.role: Compiles Remastered's visor effect data: any VE* property marks it present; VisorGoo reads the VESN/VESM size range.

items.name: CIEAbsoluteValue
items.role: Int ABS_ element: absolute value of the child; the port's int version keeps INT_MIN as INT_MIN.

items.name: CIERandom
items.role: Remastered int RAND: min + Next() % (max - min + 1); the port's PRAN mirrors it.

items.name: CIERandomConstant
items.role: Constant-argument int RAND, same formula as CIERandom (port_remastered_effect_convert.cpp:1977-1978).

items.name: CIERandom2
items.role: Raw Next() for a constant RAND with min <= 0, which retail's RAND gives.

items.name: CIEInitialRandomConstant
items.role: Constant IRND: min + Next() % (max - min + 1), the same formula the port's PRAN uses.

items.name: CIERealToInt
items.role: Real-to-int conversion (fcvtzs): saturates, and NaN goes to 0.

items.name: CIEKeyframeInput::GetConstOverride
items.role: Answers false, so keyframe inputs are never folded to constants.

items.name: CParticleSceneNode::ConstructDepthBias
items.role: Wraps a generator's draws in a depth-bias scope computed at the bounds centre's view depth.

items.name: UpdateRenderData_Swoosh
items.role: Swoosh ring writer: radius is RRAD for a <= 0 and LRAD for 0 < a <= 180.

items.name: UpdateRenderData_Electric2
items.role: Electric2 ribbon update: u advances 1/TSPN per segment, or 1/nodes when TSPN is absent.

items.name: CCEMultiply
items.role: Colour MULT combinator: per-channel a * b (CColor4f::Modulate); the port clamps to [0, 1].

items.name: CCEModifyAlphaOnly
items.role: Colour MDAO: RGB of the colour with alpha set to max(real, 0).

items.name: CCEGradient::GetValue
items.role: Gradient colour element: HDR float stops evaluated at the integer frame. Alias CCEGradient (CColorElement.hpp:126) merged.

items.name: GetValue
items.role: Bare name, class not stated. Remastered SPEV (sphere with variance): n1 polar bands by n2 azimuth sectors, jittered.

items.name: GetValue
items.role: Bare name, class not stated. Remastered ELPS (ellipsoid), zero euler: three draws pick a direction, stretched by size.

items.name: CVEAngleSphere::GetValue
items.role: Remastered ASPR sphere with REUL as three angles. Alias CVEAngleSphere (tests/port_particle_math.cpp:227) merged.

items.name: CVEAngleSphereWithVariance::GetValue
items.role: Remastered ASPV: sphere split into polar bands by azimuth sectors, each cell jittered. Alias GetValue (PortParticleMath.hpp:1006) merged.

items.name: CVEAngleSphereWithVariance::Compile
items.role: Compile step for ASPV: counts and shuffler follow SPEV's rules.

items.name: PLNE GetValue
items.role: Remastered PLNE point in a plane: two draws across the half sizes, spread toward the normal, turned by the matrix. Alias PLNE (CEmitterElement.hpp:104) merged.

items.name: ModifyWithSpreadAngle
items.role: Lifts the velocity toward the plane normal by the point's offset; the port's PlaneModifyWithSpread mirrors it.

items.name: GetValue
items.role: Bare name, class not stated. Remastered PLNV (plane with variance): nx by nz cells, jittered.

items.name: CComplexKeepInitial::RebaseComplexOp
items.role: KPIN outside a system variable is latched once per particle or swoosh point at birth.

items.name: CreateSWSH
items.role: Swoosh handling of the SHTM shutdown property: 0 stops emission, 1 also destroys live particles (port-only PSHM).

items.name: CreateSWSH
items.role: Swoosh handling of DFOG 1: sets the description's no-fog bit (port-only PDFG).

items.name: CParticleLight::Create
items.role: Divides LINT by the static exposure; the port's ParticleLightGain depends on this.

items.name: PushTransferData
items.role: Multiplies the tint's alpha by the X-Ray opacity multiplier that CScriptWaterMP1::Render (0xd19404) sets.

items.name: FilterLights
items.role: CPU light gather for the port's room lights, mirroring the native clustered-light gather.

items.name: CRenderPass_ClusteredLightGather::BuildClusteredData
items.role: Clustered light gather: cluster grid, 80-byte light records, 32-bit mask per cluster.

items.name: SetupClusterContextBase
items.role: Sets up the clustered-light cluster context.

items.name: CullLightsGPUByType
items.role: Native GPU light-mask build from CScene's light cache; the port does the same gather on the CPU.

items.name: InitializeRenderNodes
items.role: Registers a baked-lighting probe tile copy when an area loads.

items.name: CColorGradeManager::OnHintChangedCallback
items.role: Null hint with no grade requested: returns without a transition, so the last grade keeps full weight.

items.name: CVolumetricFogHintGOC::AcceptScriptMsg
items.role: Accepts AddHintRequest, RemoveHintRequest, ReallyRemoveHint (DLEX), QueryHintState and (de)activation messages.

items.name: TransitionTonemapParams
items.role: One step of a move between tonemap parameter sets (6 values); retargeting keeps the from-values and progress.

items.name: InitStaticRenderStateImpl
items.role: Maps an electric's EBDM byte to a blend row: 1 additive, 2 premultiplied, 0 and 3-5 alpha.

items.name: CalculatePointsForBolt
items.role: Electric2 bolt point generation (ELC2), pure math.

items.name: CalculatePointsForBoltBranches
items.role: Electric2 bolt branch point generation, pure math.

items.name: CalculateFractal
items.role: Electric2 fractal displacement for bolts, pure math.

items.name: UpdateElectricalEffects
items.role: Ages and re-evaluates Electric2 bolts per step, removing expired ones.

items.name: CreateNewParticles
items.role: Bakes Electric2 bolts into world space at creation.

items.name: InitBoltNodePosition
items.role: Bakes bolt nodes to world space: pos = xf * (pt * scale).

items.name: InitBoltNodeOrientation
items.role: Per-node bolt orientation: NFOM and SIDE rules, with degenerate-frame fallbacks.

items.name: UpdateBolt
items.role: Per-bolt update for Electric2 (ELC2).

items.name: DeactivateProjectile
items.role: Calls ShutdownEffect on the projectile's generators and swooshes; the DestroyParticles call is not ported.

items.name: SRenderContext::Load
items.role: Reads the render-context block in one go, then SChannel::Load.

items.name: SChannel::Load
items.role: Reads a channel list: u8 count, then per channel a pooled name, i16, two bools and a guid.

items.name: abs_bone_rel_inv_scale
items.role: Bone local transform as diag(1/Sp) * R * diag(S), Sp the parent's scale; translation kept.

items.name: NAnimOp::dquant_bits
items.role: Dequantises one bit per value (type 3) into custom variables.

items.name: tween_real32
items.role: Real32 track dequant: value = cur / 2^realExp (type 4).

items.name: tween_scale_for_coords
items.role: Uses one real32 value for all three axes of a scale.

items.name: CAnimCompStream::Load
items.role: Loads a compressed animation record (01, id, length, payload); end is the size field's position plus size.

items.name: NAnimComp::init_dequant_real32
items.role: Stores real32 dequant parameters per track: bit width, exponent, signed flag.

items.name: init_dequant_int32
items.role: Reads int32 dequant parameters: bit width and signed flag for int32 value tracks.

items.name: UnionWith
items.role: Touches only behavior and filter in the material translation, per the source comment.

items.name: EmptyCollisionMaterial
items.role: Empty collision material value; the CCollisionMaterial ctor is at 0xbea8c8.

items.name: NCollisionUtils::is_floor
items.role: Floor test on contact orientation and up component. Alias is_floor (port_remastered_box_landing.h:72) merged.

items.name: NCollisionUtils::is_wall
items.role: Wall orientation test, a sibling of is_floor and is_ceiling.

items.name: NCollisionUtils::is_ceiling
items.role: Ceiling orientation test, a sibling of is_floor and is_wall.

items.name: NCollisionUtils::is_ceiling_normal
items.role: Contact normal counts as ceiling when up < -0.70710677.

items.name: GetTransformedAABox
items.role: Bare name, class not stated. A platform's box is translated with it and never turned.

items.name: CCollidableAABox
items.role: Collidable type 0 (AABox). Unclear from the comment whether this address is the ctor or a method.

items.name: CCollidableAABox::AABox_AABox
items.role: Box-vs-box pair test for the stepped-mover failsafe; impacts via 0xbf6650.

items.name: NCollisionRayCast::Sphere
items.role: Sphere sweep, the swept-sphere part of the collision failsafe.

items.name: NCollisionRayCast::Sphere
items.role: Ray vs sphere through the CCollidableSphere::RayCast wrapper; a start inside returns code 1 with t = 0.

items.name: NCollisionRayCast::Capsule
items.role: Ray vs capsule query that the Remastered ball mover sweeps.

items.name: Source::Reciprocal
items.role: FRECPE plus two FRECPS reciprocal; the port's test block for it.

items.name: NCollisionRayCast::InfiniteCylinder
items.role: Ray vs infinite cylinder query used by the ball mover sweep. Alias Source::InfiniteCylinder (tests) merged.

items.name: NCollisionRayCast::AABox
items.role: Ray vs AABox, part of the box failsafe.

items.name: TriangleNoBackface
items.role: Ray vs triangle, front faces only (mode 1).

items.name: NCollidablePairs::Sphere_Sphere_Swept
items.role: Sphere-vs-sphere swept query over the shared contact helpers.

items.name: NormalizeWithMagnitude
items.role: Normalises the sweep delta; the penetration depth is (r0 + r1) - m. Bare name in source.

items.name: CCollidableSphere::RayCast
items.role: Sphere ray-cast wrapper: passes the translated centre and untouched radius to NCollisionRayCast::Sphere.

items.name: CCollidableSphere::Sphere_Sphere
items.role: Overlap contact for two spheres in the swept query.

items.name: CCollidableSphere::AABox_Sphere
items.role: Box-vs-sphere contact; the exterior distance uses the ARM estimate refined once.

items.name: NCollisionBoolean::Sphere_Sphere
items.role: Sphere overlap gate: strict compare of squared distance against (r0 + r1)^2.

items.name: NCollidableBoxTree::build_collision_info
items.role: Builds collision info for a terrain box-tree leaf triangle.

items.name: CCollidableOBBoxTree
items.role: Collidable type 4 (OBB tree, the DCLN platforms). Unclear from the comment whether this address is the ctor or a method.

items.name: AABox_OBBoxTree
items.role: Traversal of an OBB tree against a box: LIFO, leaves go through the terrain producer 0xc0a180. Bare name, class not stated.

items.name: COrientationCollisionFilter::Passes
items.role: Orientation filter: returns true for orientation -1 here; the MP1 wrapper rejects it first.
